translations.name: Kansas Housing Resources Corporation (KHRC)
translations.description: KHRC connects Kansas residents with housing help. You can find help with rent, help paying for home energy, programs for buying a home, and other housing help. Eligibility varies by program. Use the site to find programs and local providers that serve your area.
translations.website_description: Find help with housing, rent, home energy costs, and buying a home in Kansas.
